title: Staff Software Engineer
jobDescription: We are seeking an experienced senior software engineer to drive complex feature enhancements, architecture improvements, and high-tier escalation resolution for our enterprise security product suite. In this role, you will balance core software engineering—designing cross-platform components, APIs, and distributed systems—with deep debugging and hotfix engineering for critical customer issues. Key Responsibilities Design and implement new software components and new features that meet functional and business requirements on schedule and within budget. Utilize different programming languages to create cross-platform code (UNIX, Linux, Mac, and Windows platforms) that will run in physical (hardware) and virtual environments (Azure and AWS). Define communication interfaces between software components, implement new product APIs, and consume 3rd party interfaces in product software components. Utilize network protocols and apply software clustering models to build distributed enterprise-grade software that can be deployed and synchronized in multiple datacenters across the globe. Use Relational Databases (SQL) and Directories (LDAP). Design database tables and schemas to store product-specific information and integrate the product with customers' provided databases and LDAP directories. Utilize modern UI frameworks for development of end-user-facing interfaces, web protocols, and REST APIs. Work collaboratively within an Agile Team to write high-quality, testable code that meets the Definition of Done. Perform unit/module testing of software to find errors and confirm programs meet specifications. Utilize unit testing frameworks to build unit tests. Implement end-to-end automation tests. Provide information to technical writers and conduct training sessions on new modules or code changes to other members of the product cross-functional team. Integrate new product features and tests into the continuous integration toolchain. Leverage AI-assisted development tools and identify opportunities to adopt innovative technologies. Troubleshoot product issues, fix defects, and work closely with customers to drive platform quality. Utilize debugging and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex configuration issues or product defects reported by the customers. Work on recreating product issues in the lab environment and be able to troubleshoot issues in customer environments using remote tools. Provide guidance and best practices on product deployment models and configurations. Support regular cadence of product update releases such as service packs and produce individual hotfixes and code patches. Skills Required Strong design, programming (Java, C, C++, PHP, Perl, SQL, and shell scripts), and debugging skills with experience on enterprise-class applications. Strong knowledge of Windows / Unix / Linux operating systems Internals and experience with cross-platform software development Very good at debugging multi-threaded, high-performance applications Ability to use AI tools effectively to improve efficiency and productivity Enterprise Security domain knowledge and experience (authentication/authorization frameworks, security protocols, PKI, certificates, SSL, Privileged Access and Identity use cases) Good communication, coaching, and mentoring skills. Work Experience Typically, 10+ years of experience in software development What makes you a strong fit? AI Expertise: You are an expert in using AI code assist tools (Claude/Cursor, etc.) as coworkers and not as prompt engineers. Good understanding of AI Spec-driven development methodologies like Plan/BMAD mode, etc., and use it thoroughly to map out and implement all phases of SDLC. Understand agent orchestration and manage multi-agent workflows to handle complex, multi-step engineering tasks like new capabilities, codebase refactoring, upgrades, and vulnerability patching. Code Review & Quality Control: Critically review AI-generated code for architectural alignment, design, and performance bottlenecks. Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law. If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence. Welcome! Thank you for your interest in Broadcom! We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. For more information please visit our video library and check out our Connected by Broadcom series. Follow us on Linked In Broadcom Inc.

title: R&D Engineer Software 5
jobDescription: As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing hardware abstraction layer for BRCM switching silicon. You will work cross functionally with marketing, architects, software test, and silicon development to design, implement, document and test high quality software. This is a unique opportunity to deliver software for a dis-aggregated software solution with high performance and scale. This position provides the opportunity to work on the most advanced switching ASICs made by Broadcom. jobDescription:
Job Description: Staff Software Engineer
- Full-Stack & AI-Assisted Engineering Modern Full-Stack Software Engineering with AI Coding Tools Proficiency & Technical Leadership Position Overview We are seeking a highly passionate and skilled engineer to lead and execute full-stack enterprise product engineering initiatives. This senior role requires deep full-stack engineering expertise across Java, React, and containerization technologies (Docker), combined with advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to drive engineering velocity and architectural excellence across the team. The ideal candidate will lead development across enterprise product lines (Agile Requirements Designer, Service Virtualization, and Test Data Manager), architectural design, complex problem solving, and mentorship of engineering peers. Key Responsibilities
1. Architectural Leadership & Solution Design Lead technical design, architecture, and feature implementation across complex, multi-component enterprise software products. Champion and scale AI-assisted development practices (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot) across the engineering team to maximize velocity and code quality. Perform deep root-cause analysis for complex system defects and architect robust, scalable fixes across backend and frontend stacks. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and UX leads to translate business requirements into technical blueprints.
2. Senior Hands-On Development & Implementation Architect and write scalable, highly maintainable, and robust code using Java 17+ (Spring Boot) and modern React (Type Script). Design containerized microservice architectures using Docker and Kubernetes orchestration configurations. Build, optimize, and maintain complex RESTful APIs, asynchronous messaging, and database schemas. Establish advanced workflows in AI coding environments (Cursor, Claude Code) to automate refactoring, test generation, and documentation. Conduct high-rigor peer code reviews, ensuring strict compliance with security baselines, design patterns, and quality standards.
3. Quality Engineering & AI System Validation Architect end-to-end testing strategies covering unit, integration, performance, and security testing across microservices and AI-enabled modules. Implement automated verification pipelines for AI/ML features, ensuring correctness, accuracy, and edge-case resilience. Monitor enterprise application performance in production, establishing observability, logging, and automated alerting metrics.
4. Technical Mentorship & Process Innovation Define technical standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices for the organization. Mentor engineers on advanced full-stack techniques, system design, and pragmatic AI-assisted workflows. Evaluate and introduce innovative technologies, tools, and frameworks that deliver clear business and technical ROI. Required Technical Expertise Core Programming Languages & Frameworks Java 17+: Spring Boot 3.5+, Microservices, REST APIs, Performance Tuning React: Type Script, Java Script ES6+, hooks, custom state management Docker & Container Orchestration: Dockerfile optimization, multi-stage builds, Kubernetes/EKS SQL & Data Architecture: Complex query optimization, schema design AI Coding Tools & Workflows AI-Assisted Development Tools: Expert-level proficiency in Cursor IDE (agentic workflows, context windows), Claude Code CLI, Git Hub Copilot. Prompt & Agent Workflows: Advanced prompt engineering, context orchestration, and automated agent workflows for engineering teams. Enterprise Technology Stack Backend Architecture: Spring Boot, Microservices, Event-driven architecture, RESTful APIs, Graph QL Frontend Ecosystem: React, Type Script, Angular (legacy maintenance/migration), Vite, Webpack Databases: Postgre SQL, My SQL, MSSQL, Oracle, Mongo DB (No SQL), database migration frameworks Dev Ops & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git Lab CI, Gradle, Maven Security & Compliance: Keycloak, OAuth2, JWT, PII detection, and secure coding practices Required Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. Minimum of 12+ years of hands-on software development experience in full-stack enterprise product engineering. Proven technical leadership track record delivering enterprise-grade software products built with Java/Spring Boot, React, and Docker. Mastered hands-on usage of modern AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code) in daily development workflows. Proven ability to mentor engineers and drive architectural standards across engineering groups. Leadership & Soft Skills Senior customer-first mindset with strong technical communication skills. Proven problem-solving ability in high-scale, distributed system environments. Pragmatic engineering leader focused on delivering tangible business value and continuous technical innovation. What You'll Be Working On Agile Requirements Designer (ARD): Requirements management and test automation platform. Service Virtualization (SV): Service virtualization and API mocking platform. Test Data Manager (TDM): Test data management and synthetic data generation. Work Environment & Application Details Location: Hyderabad, India Employment Type: Full-time Onsite Expectation: 5 days per week Travel: Minimal (as needed) Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Analog Layout Engineer
jobDescription:
Analog layout designer providing onsite support for advanced nodes, working with global layout and design team.

jobDescription: As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing hardware abstraction layer for BRCM switching silicon. Hands-on experience in using ASIC SDK to program forwarding plane data, including ipv4/ipv6 hosts and prefixes, adjacency, ARP and ND6, VRF, ECMP, etc. Strong forwarding plane experience in applications such L2, L3, ACL, Qo S, Tunnels, SRv6, Telemetry is required. title: Senior Memory Design Engineer
jobDescription:
JD for Senior Design Engineer 1) Contribute/Lead towards Design and Development of Single/Multiport SRAM, Register file compilers in 28nm/16FF/7FF/5FF Technologies 2) Circuit design/simulation of key components such as bitcell, WL decoder, SAMP, Column decoder and control logic. 3) Development of critical path and characterization flow to perform detailed margin and characterization simulations. 4) Statistical Analysis of Bit-Cell and Sense Amplifier and Self Time Blocks for Compiler Target yield Sign-Off 5) Design Tuning, Margin Analysis and Sign-Off for Complete Compiler to meet Yield and Performance targets. 6) Logic simulations and detailed timing analysis of key paths in high speed memory design. 7) Signal-Integrity (EM) and Power-Integrity (IR drop) analysis and design. Skill Sets/Prerequisites 1) Expertise of high speed/low power CMOS circuit design, clocking scheme, Static and dynamic logic circuits 2) Experience in Designing and driving one or many Memory Compilers Specifications to final release 3) Deep expertise in Understanding and Developing Split rail, Power gating Architecture and circuit design 4) Hands on Experience on Silicon Debug/Diagnose the failures. Deep expertise on Silicon Failures, Analysis and fixing. 5 Complete hands on experience in using Cadence/Mentor schematic/layout editor tools 6) Complete hands on experience with Circuit simulation, MC analysis and waveform viewer tools such as HSPICE, HSIM, XA, Fin Sim, XARA, n Wave, waveform viewer etc 7) Experience in Skill/Perl/Python Scripting is a strong plus 8) Experience in Understanding the layout design issues in sub nanometer regime is a must.
9. Expertise in Understanding Memory DFT is a Plus.
10. Masters Degree with 4+ Years or Bachelors Degree with 5+ years Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: DFT Manager
jobDescription: DFT manager is expected to manage and technically guide a high-performing DFT team focused on various ASIC engagements. DFT manager shall also be required to execute certain DFT critical tasks. As a part of the profile, DFT manager shall define chip-level testing plans, including Scan, MBIST, IO/IP tests. Should be able to Collaborate with physical design, verification, and manufacturing teams on optimal DFT architectures. Work with Automated Test Equipment (ATE) post-silicon to achieve test coverage, root cause failures and improve manufacturing yield. title: Staff Design Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description The position requires a breadth of disciplines and responsibilities in supporting the Processor based subsystem verification for the ‘ASIC Products Division’ within Broadcom Limited. Responsibilities will include Verification environment Development, Verification, Functional verification, performance verification, Coverage Closure, Gate simulations, releases, reviews etc. Typical subsystems are based on ARM processors like A72, A55, A53, R8, AMBA Bus matrixes like NOC, CCI, NIC and memory controllers like HBM, Memory management Units MMU/SMMU and various peripherals. Responsibilities will be both individual and team based with ability to work cross functionally across the organization. Requirements/Qualifications (Education) B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Electronics/VLSI Engineering with strong 6+ years of experience in Processor subsystem verification in both directed and random verification Experience in ARM Processor based subsystem verification using ARM asm and C language Good exposure to latest ARM processor architectures, Bus Interconnects and AMBA protocols – CHI, AXI, AHB, APB Experience in Verilog, System Verilog and UVM based testbench and environment development. Working knowledge of Verilog, and have programming skills in Perl and TCL scripting languages Expertise to develop block level / subsystem level verification environments using System Verilog and UVM is a must. Demonstrate the ability to work through technology challenges with high-performance design verification. Additionally, the candidate should possess excellent communications and inter-personal skills to work closely with other team members and be self-motivated to learn new tools and design flows Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: R & D Software Engineer
jobDescription: About the job We are seeking talented, self-motivated, and experienced Software Engineer with a passion for building high-quality software systems using Agile practices. In this role, you will be a key member of the development team and will focus on AI driven designing, implementing, testing, and supporting leading edge security products on API Management & Observability used by many of the world’s largest companies. Educational
minimumQualification: B.Tech/B.E/M.Tech/M.E (Experience : 14+ years) What makes you a strong fit AI Expertise: You are an expert in using AI Code assist tools (Claude/Cursor etc) as Coworkers and not as prompt engineers. Good understanding of AI Spec driven development methodologies like Plan/BMAD mode etc and use it thoroughly, to map out and implement all phases of SDLC. Understand Context Engineering & Token Optimization techniques and create/maintain reusable skills, contexts across multiple teams and repos. Understand Agent Orchestration, manage multi-agent workflows to handle complex, multi-step engineering tasks like new capabilities, codebase refactoring, upgrades, and vulnerability patching. Code Review & Quality Control: Critically review AI-generated code for architectural alignment, design, and performance bottlenecks. Required Skills : Expertise in Java & GO and related technologies. Expertise in Container Technologies (like Helm, Docker, Kubernetes) Expertise in any cloud service - AWS, Azure , GCP etc. Expertise in Restful Web services. Good understanding of React or similar technologies. Good understanding of Scalable Distributed Systems. Good understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills. Desired Skills : Database : MySQL and Cloud Databases. Linux : Debian, RHEL, others. Security : Secure coding practices and understanding of OWASP, OAuth etc. Protocols : HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, GraphQL etc. Key Responsibilities : Be responsible for defining, developing, and evolving software in a fast-paced and agile development environment. E2E ownership in leading features from incubation to delivery. Understand product requirements & vision Work with tech leaders and architects to develop implementation plans Drive world-class quality in the development and support of products Strive to be subject-matter experts of complex systems. Apply principles of Software Development Life Cycle and methodologies like Agile, Continuous Integration, Software and Product Security, Scalability, Documentation Practices, refactoring and Testing Techniques Understand performance parameters and assess application performance Proactively share information across the team with the appropriate level of detail and timeliness Work with Junior engineers to mentor, review code and setup best practices/tools/frameworks Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Engineering Program Manager
jobDescription:
As a Client-Facing Program Manager at Broadcom-Payment Security division, you will play a pivotal role in our mission to enhance payment security for our clients. You will be responsible for managing and coordinating programs, ensuring the successful implementation and ongoing support for our clients. Your expertise in the payment security industry, particularly in 3D Secure, will be critical in driving client satisfaction and maintaining our reputation as a trusted partner. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Client Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients in the payment industry, understanding their specific needs , working with them to create and manage the lifecycle of Statement of work.
2. Program Management: Define and develop statement of work (SOW), Oversee the end-to-end execution of the projects, including planning, implementation, and monitoring progress to ensure on-time and on-budget delivery while working with multi-geographical customers
3. Risk Assessment: Assess potential risks in the plan, and work collaboratively with clients & internal stakeholders to mitigate these risks effectively.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Service accounting, legal, product development, customer success team, Engineering and technical support, to ensure seamless integration and support of the solutions.
5. Reporting and Documentation: Generate regular reports on program progress and performance, keeping clients informed and making data-driven recommendations for improvements.
6. Compliance: Ensure that all programs and solutions adhere to industry standards and compliance regulations, and guide clients in maintaining compliance.
7. 3D Secure Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert in 3D Secure technology, keeping up-to-date with industry trends and regulations.

title: Staff Software Engineer
jobDescription: Senior Linux Systems Engineer – Security & Identity Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Linux systems engineer with over 10 years of specialized experience in low-level C/C++ systems programming, cryptographic network security, and enterprise identity integration. In this role, you will architect, build, and secure core Linux infrastructure components. You will be responsible for designing high-throughput Linux daemons, authoring custom PAM modules, automating X.509 certificate lifecycles, and hardening enterprise software against complex, system-level vulnerabilities. Key Responsibilities Low-Level Systems Development: Architect and build high-performance, fault-tolerant Linux daemons using modern C/C++ and POSIX APIs. Identity & Authentication Engineering: Design and implement custom Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) and integrate systems seamlessly with enterprise identity providers (Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos, SSSD). Cryptography & PKI Management: Implement robust end-to-end transport and storage security using Open SSL/Wolf SSL APIs; manage and automate X.509 PKI certificate lifecycles, m TLS configurations, and cryptographic operations. System Hardening & Security: Enforce system safety across Linux environments using granular security policies (Seccomp, SELinux/App Armor) and secure coding standards (constant-time cryptographic execution, memory safety). Network Analysis & Debugging: Diagnose, trace, and resolve complex network- and protocol-level bottlenecks or security flaws across TCP/IP stacks using advanced tools. Required Qualifications & Technical Expertise Experience 10+ years of hands-on experience in Linux systems programming, enterprise security engineering, or low-level software architecture. Technical Domain Capabilities Languages & Toolchains: Proficient in C, C++, POSIX APIs, CMake, Make, GCC/Clang, GDB, and advanced Shell Scripting (Bash). Linux Systems Programming: Deep knowledge of IPC (Unix Sockets, Shared Memory, Message Queues), Concurrency/Threading (pthreads), Asynchronous Event Loops (epoll, io_uring), Custom Daemon development, and manual Memory Management. Cryptography & Security: Direct API-level experience with Open SSL/Wolf SSL, TLS 1.2/1.3, m TLS, X.509 PKI, PEM/DER encoding, symmetric/asymmetric ciphers, HMAC, and constant-time cryptographic programming. Authentication & Identity Integration: Demonstrated experience with PAM module development, Active Directory (AD), LDAP, SSSD, Kerberos/GSSAPI, and enterprise OAuth2/OIDC protocols. Networking & Linux Hardening: Expert understanding of TCP/IP, socket-level programming, Seccomp sandboxing, App Armor/SELinux mandatory access control, and network tracing tools (tcpdump, Wireshark). AI-Assisted Engineering Practice: AI Collaboration: Demonstrated expertise leveraging advanced AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force-multiplier co-workers to accelerate low-level engineering workflows. Spec-Driven Methodology: Strong foundation in AI spec-driven development practices (e.g., Plan/BMAD modes) to design, map, and implement full SDLC phases. AI Code Review & Governance: Ability to critically inspect, profile, and audit AI-generated code for zero-trust security, memory safety, architectural integrity, and performance bottlenecks. jobDescription: Work as part of Mixed Signal and IO Library Development team in Central Engineering. Primary responsibilities include: Design and verification of IO interfaces and mixed signal blocks such as POR, process monitors, voltage/temperature sensors, crystal oscillators etc. RTL coding, synthesis and verification of digital wrappers that interface with analog circuitry Interface with both custom and P&R layout engineers and oversee physical design and verification. title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description: Product Manager, AI-Powered Network Observability
- Broadcom About Broadcom: Broadcom Inc. is a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. Broadcom’s category-leading product portfolio serves critical markets including data center, networking, enterprise software, broadband, wireless, and storage. About Broadcom Network Observability: Broadcom Network Observability delivers cutting-edge solutions for network monitoring, analysis, and automation, empowering enterprises to optimize network performance and ensure business continuity. We are at the forefront of leveraging AI and machine learning to revolutionize network observability and provide unparalleled insights. Job Summary: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-powered network observability solutions within Broadcom Network Observability. This role will focus on leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhance network visibility, automate anomaly detection, and provide actionable insights for our customers. You will be responsible for defining the product roadmap, working closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams, and ensuring the successful delivery of innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our enterprise customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for AI-powered network observability solutions. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product strategy. Prioritize features and initiatives based on customer needs, market trends, and business goals. Product Development and Execution: Collaborate with engineering and design teams to translate product requirements into detailed specifications and user stories. Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality releases. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and identify areas for improvement. AI and Machine Learning Integration: Drive the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into our network observability platform. Work with data scientists and engineers to develop and implement AI models for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and predictive analytics. Ensure that AI-driven insights are presented in a clear and actionable manner for our customers. Customer Engagement and Advocacy: Engage with customers and partners to gather feedback and understand their needs. Serve as a product evangelist, presenting product demos and providing technical expertise to customers and internal stakeholders. Work with marketing and sales teams to develop product messaging and go-to-market strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and support, to ensure alignment and successful product delivery. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Work with UX designers to create intuitive and useful user interfaces.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred). 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in the network observability or IT operations domain. Strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and their application to network monitoring and analysis. Experience with network protocols, technologies, and monitoring tools. Proven track record of successfully launching and managing complex software products. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Experience with cloud based technologies and Saa S product delivery. Experience with Network performance Monitoring and Diagnostics (NPMD) solutions. Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with large-scale data processing and analysis. Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and microservices architectures. Experience with Agile development methodologies. Experience in the networking industry. Benefits: Broadcom offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. To Apply: Please submit your resume and cover letter online. We look forward to hearing from you! Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law. We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. For more information please visit our video library and check out our Connected by Broadcom series. Follow us on Linked In Broadcom Inc.

jobDescription:
Job Description: About the job We are seeking talented, self-motivated and experienced Quality Engineering (QE) lead to drive end-to-end quality assurance initiatives. In this role, you will be a key member of the Quality Assurance team with focus on test strategy, test plan, test automation, test tools, AI-driven testing methodologies, CI/CD integration, enterprise grade system validation and release management for leading edge security products on API Management & Observability used by many of the world’s largest companies. Educational

QUALIFICATIONS:

B.Tech/B.E/M.Tech/M.E (Experience : 14+ years) What makes you a strong fit AI Expertise: You are an expert in using AI Code assist tools (Claude/Cursor etc) as Coworkers and not as prompt engineers. Good understanding of AI Spec driven development methodologies like Plan/BMAD mode etc and use it thoroughly, to map out and implement all phases of SDLC. Understand Context Engineering & Token Optimization techniques and create/maintain reusable skills, contexts across multiple teams and repos. Understand Agent Orchestration, manage multi-agent workflows to handle complex, multi-step engineering tasks like new capabilities, codebase refactoring, upgrades, and vulnerability patching. Code Review & Quality Control: Critically review AI-generated code for architectural alignment, design, and performance bottlenecks. Required Skills: Seasoned in Test Automation frameworks like Playwright, Selenium, Test NG Experience with REST API Testing Experienced in Cloud & Virtual Appliance Test Execution Platforms Exposed to CI/CD Integration with Jenkins Experienced with automed Integration Testing & System Validation Experienced in Test data generation, Data Validation & Reconciliation Testing Experience in managing Product release hardening & rollout Expertise in AI-assisted tools for quality engineering solutions Proven experience in leading Agile QA Test & Automation strategy Expertise in working with project management tools Ex. JIRA/Rally & Test Management Tools Ex.Testrail/q Test or similar Experience in defect management, reporting, and quality governance. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead quality engineering responsibilities for enterprise grade software products in Agile delivery teams. Drive test strategy, planning, execution, tools, automation, and release readiness activities Implement AI-driven testing approaches for test & data generation, prioritization, defect analysis, and quality insights. Monitor/govern the test automation that includes API testing, Playwright, Selenium, Test NG, Java, and REST APIs. Manage test execution on cloud-based and virtual appliance platforms Validate complex system integrations, enterprise data flows, and downstream business impacts. Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish continuous quality gates. Monitor quality metrics, risks, defect trends, and production readiness. Collaborate with Product, Development, and Business stakeholders to ensure comprehensive test coverage. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and drive continuous quality improvements. Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobDescription: Job Description: Design full custom layouts of I/O libraries and Analog Mixed Signal IP's in planar and Fin FET technologies. Drive critical floor-planning decisions to ensure optimal placement and routing that meets design requirements and performance metric. Perform comprehensive layout verification to ensure high quality and compliance Complete ownership from end to end deliverables with quality within the schedule. Adapt quickly to new methodologies, remain open to new ideas, and communicate effectively with the teams across all sites. Expertise in Layout verifications and debugging: DRC/LVS/ANT/ERC/DFM, LPE, PERC, EM and IR etc Familiar with the Physical Design flow: LEF generation and Pn R Knowledge of AI, automation in layout, Script Programming and SKILL Programming is a plus. title: Memory Layout Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description: Job Requirements: Minimum 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree, strong layout knowledge. Proficiency in using Cadence tools (Virtuoso Layout, Layout XL, Cadence Schematic Capture, and verification tools
- Calibre & Hercules). Strong layout knowledge in advanced submicron Fin FET processes, including TSMC 5nm, 3nm, 2nm, A14 or Samsung lower Fin FET nodes. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Understand and apply layout guidelines, new process rules, and technical requirements for high-quality layouts. Manage scheduling, timelines, and layout floor-planning. Ensure end-to-end deliverables are completed with high quality and within the planned schedule. Adapt quickly to new methodologies and communicate effectively with the SOC and library teams. Skill Set(Memory): Proven ability to manage schedules, timelines, and end-to-end deliverables. Experienced in leading teams, training junior engineers, and documenting layout methodologies and guidelines. Proficient in Cadence tools, including Virtuoso Layout, Layout XL, VXL, EXL, and Cadence Schematic Capture. Strong experience in memory layout design and physical verification (LVS, DRC, ERC, Antenna, Electro Migration) in CMOS processes. Extensive experience with physical verification tools such as Calibre and Hercules (DRC, LVS, ERC, Antenna, and Softcheck Errors). Proficiency in floor-planning, hierarchy layout, and chip integration. Solid understanding of memory architecture and RC requirements, with the ability to plan signal and power routing. Knowledge of AI, layout automation, and script/SKILL programming is preferred. Ability to lead new technology reviews to document layout methodologies, flows, and guidelines. title: Senior Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description: Candidate would be required to work on various phases of SOC physical design activities. The job will include but not limited to block level – floor-planning, partitioning, placement, clock tree synthesis, route, physical verification (LVS/DRC/ERC/Antenna etc). The job will include but not limited to block level – floor-planning, partitioning, placement, clock tree synthesis, route, physical verification (LVS/DRC/ERC/Antenna etc). Should be able to meet congestion, timing and area metrics. Candidate would be required to do equivalence checks, STA, Crosstalk delay analysis ,noise analysis, power optimization. Should be able to implement timing and functional ECOs. Should have excellent problem solving skill to help through congestion resolution and timing closure. Should have experience formal verification and timing analysis and ECO implementation. Experience with tools such as Innovus/Encounter, ICC, Caliber, LEC, Primetime etc is highly desirable. Candidate should be able to work independently and guide other team members. Should be experienced in working in a global team and dynamic environment. Should possess ability to learn and adapt to new tools and methodologies. Excellent communication skill is a must. Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law. If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence. Welcome! Thank you for your interest in Broadcom! We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. For more information please visit our video library and check out our Connected by Broadcom series. Follow us on Linked In Broadcom Inc.

title: R&D Engineer IC Design
jobDescription:
Job Description: Designs and develops integrated circuits. Oversees definition, design, verification, and documentation for ASIC development. Determines architecture design, logic design, and system simulation. Defines module interfaces/formats for simulation. Contributes to the development of multidimensional designs involving the layout of complex integrated circuits. Evaluates all aspects of the process flow from high-level design to synthesis, place and route, and timing and power use. Analyzes equipment to establish operation data, conducts experimental tests, and evaluates results. May also review vendor capability to support development.
- Knowledge: Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. • Strong project management skills • Leads design and delivery of new products/process • Functional breadth and depth, plus expert in complementary fields • Applies broad concepts and theories to achieve innovative and effective solutions to complex problems

title: IC Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description: In this role, the Engineer will apply and lead Broadcom's proven design methodology and milestone flow to meet Broadcom's rigorous criteria for achieving Right-first time silicon. Candidate should have very good experience in layout activities of block and level. Should be well experienced in floor-planning, partitioning, placement, clock tree synthesis, route and physical verification. Responsibilities include, but not limited to: • Understanding of So C for top-down/bottom-up physical design integration in 5nm and lower technologies • Must have deep functional knowledge of P&R flows, should be able to catch up quickly on internal flows, adapt. • Implement timing and functional ECO • P&R, Extraction, Physical verification, work towards STA closure • Build automation flows wherever needed/adapt to existing flows for re-use • Must be proficient in any of the Cadence/Synospys/Mentor EDA tools for P&R, PV, STA, ECO • Needs to be automation savvy with high expertise in one of the programming languages used in the industry • Clearly know requisites for executing his/her job and lead by example • Bring tangible improvement in TAT with better quality

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:
